issue_body:
# Performance regression — 3 pages below threshold

Audited: **2026-10-01T15:31:08.180Z**

## Affected pages

| Page | Perf | LCP | TBT |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/` | 84 ↓ (was 85) | 3708 ms ↑ | 194 ms |
| `/projects/note-structurer` | 81 (unchanged) | 4196 ms ↑ | 126 ms |
| `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 78 ↑ (was 76) | 4616 ms | 132 ms |

## Why this matters
- `/` crossed below the 85 threshold this cycle (84), driven by an LCP increase of ~432 ms.
- The two project detail pages have been below 85 for multiple consecutive audit cycles with no improvement in LCP.
- TBT has improved across all three pages, suggesting script execution is not the primary bottleneck — **LCP image loading** is.

## Recommended fixes
1. **Convert hero/LCP images to WebP or AVIF** and serve with correct `srcset` / `sizes` to reduce initial payload.
2. **Add `fetchpriority="high"`** to the LCP image element on `/` and project detail pages so the browser prioritises it earlier.
3. **Preconnect or preload** critical third-party origins (e.g. fonts, CDN assets) that may be delaying LCP.
4. **Code-split** any non-critical JS bundles on project pages to reduce render-blocking time further.

## Visual status
All pages are visually intact on desktop and mobile — no layout breakage, overflow, or missing content detected.
